description:
Show the availability result for given dates and party as an interactive card in the chat.

Use after check_availability (or instead of it) when the guest wants to SEE the options: photos, total
price with an expandable breakdown, a booking button per apartment, tappable alternative dates. Use
check_availability alone when only reasoning over the data or when the client cannot display cards.
Behaviour and arguments are identical to check_availability (read-only, live, nothing booked); the result
additionally contains small photos and the Google rating. Returns the same text and structuredContent.

adults.description: TOTAL number of guests aged 18+ in the whole party — also for groups larger than one apartment (the tool plans the apartments). Guests aged 0-17 go into children.
adults.title: Adults

check_out.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD (after check_in, max. 60 nights)
check_out.title: Check Out

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0-17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'; empty if none. Ages change price and tourist tax (charged from age 17).
children.title: Children

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name: render_availability_card

alternatives.description: Nearest bookable stays: check_in, check_out, nights, from_price, cheapest, apartments[], booking_url

apartments.description: Free apartments, cheapest first: nr, total (EUR, whole stay+party), breakdown{logis, cleaning, tourist_tax, tax_persons, deposit, balance, free_cancel_until} or null, facts{name, m2, bedrooms, max_guests, url, image, photo}, booking_url

group.description: rooms[] (like apartments, plus adults, child_ages), total, alternative

offers.description: Website offers valid during the stay: title, url, price_text

perks.description: kaernten_card, greenfee (bool, for this arrival date)

query.description: check_in, check_out, nights, adults, child_ages, persons

status.description: ok: apartments free; group: several apartments needed; rule_violation: arrival/departure day or minimum stay not allowed; closed; fully_booked; not_released: beyond published dates

terms.description: deposit_pct, deposit_method, deposit_due_days, balance, card_required, tax_pp_night, tax_min_age, free_cancel_until

unavailable.description: Fitting apartments already booked: nr, name

title: Show Availability Card
